page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review rules. Text only — a skill is Markdown that agents append to their prompt, in order.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill from scratch or import a Markdown file or archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a card to preview its body, edit it, or delete it.

card.needsVettingTitle: Imported from a file — read it before enabling; a foreign skill is foreign instructions in your agent's prompt.

panel.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? Agents that link it lose it. This cannot be undone.
panel.importedNotice: Imported from a file. Read the body before enabling: a foreign skill is foreign instructions in your agent's prompt.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Kebab-case slug, unique in the workspace: pr-quality-rubric. It becomes the section heading in the prompt.
form.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — what it makes the agent do. Write it as a directive: "Flag every new branch no test reaches."
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag every new branch that no test in the diff reaches.
form.bodyHint: Appended to the agent prompt under "## Skills / rules". State what to flag, at which severity, and what to cite. Saving a changed body creates a new version.
form.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

Flag as WARNING, citing the line, any …
form.enabledHint: Disabled skills stay linked to agents but are left out of every prompt.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A named block of Markdown that agents can link, in order.
create.defaultBody:
# Rule name

When the diff …, report a WARNING citing the exact file:line and say what to change.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a Markdown file or a zip archive. Only the skill's Markdown core is read; nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.fileHint: For an archive, SKILL.md (or README.md) becomes the body. Scripts and other files are listed below and never opened or run.
import.trust: A foreign skill is foreign instructions in your agent's prompt. Read the body before enabling it — imported skills start disabled.
